claimSafe: Runs on iPhone and iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18.4 or later)
Swipe or tap to keep or delete photos and videos from the Photos library, with undo
Deleted items go to Swipeo's own trash first, where they can be restored; emptying it moves them to Recently Deleted in Photos
Review sets: screenshots, recent, selfies, bursts, Live Photos, large videos, random, on this day; also by month and by album
Duplicate photos are shown as groups with a Best badge and sort by newest, oldest or largest; not AI
Storage statistics: storage overview, media types and monthly cleanup progress
Photos are processed on the device; Swipeo does not upload them to its own servers (it uses analytics and subscription services)
Free to download with a daily limit on deletions, including one duplicate group a day; Premium (weekly or yearly) removes the limit
doNotClaim: AI detection of blurry or similar photos
Anything about iCloud-only storage or backups
